svg.title: EC2 tunnel: API traffic from allowed IPs reaches an app on a developer laptop
svg.text: EC2 tunnel: API traffic reaches an app on a developer laptop
Security group: inbound 8080 from the ALB only, no inbound SSH
request goes back through the tunnel
laptop opens SSH over SSM (outbound HTTPS)
Request path, steps 1 to 5. The response goes back the same way.
Tunnel setup, step A. The laptop opens it, and it carries the requests in steps 4 and 5.
